description: Maps Lite – Your Custom‑Shape Geospatial Power BI Visual Maps Lite is the streamlined version of the widely used Maps visual for Power BI. It offers nearly the full feature set of the original visual, but focuses entirely on scenarios where you bring your own geography. Upload your own GeoJSON or TopoJSON maps and enrich them with markers, routes, bubble charts, image markers, and true mini‑charts directly on shapes or points. Maps Lite delivers the full analytical power of Maps—without the integrated offline map library. New: Moving Dash Lines, Packed Bubble Charts, Packed Image Charts and Line Charts Maps Lite now includes three powerful new visualization features: Moving dash lines: Animate your routes to highlight direction, flow, and movement patterns across your network. Packed bubble charts: Visualize multiple category values inside a single location using tightly packed proportional circles. Perfect for composition analysis, multi‑category KPIs, and distribution insights. Packed image charts: Display multiple category values as proportional images packed inside a shape or point. Ideal for icon‑based storytelling, brand assets, or intuitive category visuals. Key Features Custom‑shape visualization: Choropleth maps, markers, routes, bubble charts, image markers, and chart‑enhanced routes – all based on your own GeoJSON or TopoJSON.
